messages:
maya: Heads-up — preflight prompt/eval run flagged a regression for the summarizer model on v2.3.4. Holding promotion for the 10:00 UTC window.
deploy-bot: Automated eval results: summary_accuracy delta -6.2%. Details: https://ci.internal/evals/1999000123 :warning: Build 2024-11-03T08:45
ben: Oof. Is that across all prompt suites or just one subset?
qa-bot: reg-suite:main -> fail (p=0.03). top10_prompts subset shows most diffs.
carol: We should pin the route to v2.3.3 for the remainder of the change window and open an investigation. Less customer impact than rollback across all regions.
tom: Agree with pin. If we pin, we'll need a quick rollback playbook in case pin doesn't hold. My plan: revert routing -> scale down v2.3.4 -> confirm traffic 0% -> monitor 15m.
ben: Pin steps? I can push a routing override. Command: ```deployctl set-route summarizer --model v2.3.3 --scope=production --ttl=15m --reason="preflight-regression"```
carol: Add an ops fallback: if pins fail, run: ```deployctl force-rollback summarizer --to v2.3.2``` and notify #incidents.
maya: Also need change-log blurb for customers and product notes: short note that we delayed rollout for quality checks. I can draft.
qa-bot: Recommended quick bisect: run prompt-suite top10 against v2.3.3 -> v2.3.4 variant with quantization off to rule out q8 artifacts. Cmds: ```eval-run --suite top10 --models v2.3.3,v2.3.4 --flags "--quant=fp16"```
deploy-bot: Canary pause applied. Job id: cb-1999000123. Traffic routed -> v2.3.3 in us-west, eu-west. :white_check_mark:
ben: I'll apply the routing override now and ping once done.
ben: Done. TTL set for 30m per request. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — can someone grab a quick regression triage? I'd rather not block the rest of the release if it's a narrow prompt issue.
carol: On it. I'll run the bisect and post findings in this thread within 30m.
tom: I'll prep rollback notes and add to the release checklist: action items for on-call, SE, and comms.
maya: Drafted customer-facing note: "We paused the summarizer rollout to investigate quality discrepancies detected in routine preflight tests. No customer data impacted; rolling back to the previous model while we triage." Posting to release notes doc and #release-updates.
carol: First quick result: diffs concentrated on prompts with list-compression. Suspect a tokenizer/fastpath change in v2.3.4. Bisect next to isolate commit. :mag: 
ben: If it's tokenizer fastpath, that's a high-risk revert. Good call to pin.
maya: OK — leaving the hold for now. If triage finds a small fixable bug we'll plan a patch release, otherwise we'll postpone next window. I'll update release calendar and notify stakeholders. :spiral_calendar: 
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary remains paused until 1999000500 or manual resume.
carol: update: narrowed to commit 7a3f2c. Creating PR to revert the regressing change. ETA for patch PR and CI: ~2h.
maya: Great. Once PR lands, run the prompt-suite again and if within tolerance, we can resume the promotion in the next change window. Thanks all. :team-heart:
